summary: Ahab tells Jezebel all Elijah did and how he killed all prophets of Baal, Jezebel sends messenger to Elijah so let gods do to me if I don't make your life as one of them tomorrow. Elijah fears rises goes for his life to Beersheba leaves servant there, himself went day's journey into wilderness comes sits under juniper tree requests to die says enough now O Yahweh take my life for I am not better than fathers, lies sleeps, angel touches arise eat behold at head cake baked on coals and cruse of water, eats lies again second time angel touches arise eat because journey too great for you, arises eats drinks goes in strength of that food 40 days 40 nights to Horeb mount of God, comes to cave lodges, word of Yahweh comes what are you doing here Elijah? He says I have been very jealous for Yahweh God of Armies for children of Israel have forsaken covenant thrown down altars slain prophets with sword and I even I only am left and they seek my life. Yahweh says go forth stand on mount before Yahweh, behold Yahweh passed by great strong wind rent mountains broke rocks but Yahweh not in wind, after wind earthquake but Yahweh not in earthquake, after earthquake fire but Yahweh not in fire, and after fire still small voice, when Elijah heard wrapped face in mantle went out stood at entrance of cave, behold voice what are you doing here? Same complaint. Yahweh says go return on way to wilderness Damascus anoint Hazael king over Syria, Jehu son of Nimshi king over Israel, Elisha son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah anoint prophet in your place, who escapes sword of Hazael Jehu shall slay Elisha shall slay, yet will I leave 7000 in Israel all knees not bowed to Baal and mouths not kissed him. So departs finds Elisha plowing with twelve yoke oxen himself with twelfth, Elijah passes casts mantle upon him, Elisha leaves oxen runs after, lets me kiss father mother then I will follow, Elijah says go back what have I done to you? Elisha takes yoke oxen slays boils flesh with instruments of oxen gives to people eats, then arises goes after Elijah ministers to him.
whyItMatters: Mount Carmel victory to Juniper breakdown — Elijah from fire from heaven to still small voice, 7000 who not bowed, mantle passing to Elisha. Shows God not only in wind earthquake fire but in whisper, and prophetic succession.

keyVerses.text: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before Yahweh.” Behold, Yahweh passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before Yahweh; but Yahweh was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake; but Yahweh was not in the earthquake.
keyVerses.why: Not in wind earthquake fire but in still small voice — qowl demamah daqah.

keyVerses.text: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him.”

But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for himself that he might die, and said, “It is enough. Now, O Yahweh, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.”
keyVerses.why: Juniper tree despair — enough, take life.

questions.question: Why does Elijah go from victory to despair wanting to die under juniper?
questions.answer: After Mount Carmel fire from heaven and rain, Jezebel threatens kill like prophets, Elijah fears, flees for life to Beersheba at edge of Judah, leaves servant, goes day into wilderness sits under juniper (broom tree) says enough now take my life not better than fathers — burnout after high, adrenal crash, isolation — I only am left. Shows even great prophet experiences depression, exhaustion after victory. Angel touches not rebukes but provides cake baked on coals and water, second time arise eat because journey too great for you — God provides rest and food before addressing theology, not just lecture.

questions.question: What does wind earthquake fire not in them still small voice mean?
questions.answer: Go stand on mount before Yahweh, wind great strong rent mountains broke rocks but Yahweh not in wind, after wind earthquake but not in earthquake, after earthquake fire but not in fire, after fire still small voice — Hebrew qowl demamah daqah — voice of thin silence, whisper, small voice. Not in dramatic phenomena (wind earthquake fire are theophany forms at Sinai) but in whisper. Elijah wraps face in mantle (like Moses cleft) goes to entrance. God not only in grand displays but in quiet. For Elijah who just saw fire from heaven, lesson is God works also in gentleness and remnant, not only spectacle.

questions.question: Who are 7000 who not bowed to Baal and why anoint Hazael Jehu Elisha?
questions.answer: Elijah says I even I only am left and they seek my life — alone complex. God says yet I have reserved 7000 in Israel all knees not bowed to Baal and mouths not kissed him — remnant unknown to Elijah, not alone. Paul quotes in Romans 11 remnant. Then anoint Hazael king over Syria, Jehu son Nimshi king over Israel, Elisha son of Shaphat prophet in your place — three anointings to bring judgment and succession. Who escapes sword of Hazael Jehu shall slay Elisha shall slay — chain of judgment on house of Ahab and idolatry. Then finds Elisha plowing twelve yoke oxen himself twelfth — wealthy farmer with twelve teams, twelfth he drives — Elijah casts mantle upon him, call. Elisha asks kiss father mother then follow, slays yoke oxen boils flesh with instruments of oxen (wood from yoke) gives to people eats — burns bridges, leaves old life, follows. Ministry begins as servant.
